name: In Service of Zephras

faq.answer: Valennia Stormfist leads the peacekeepers who protect Zephras. She directs the island's defense, including Valanaar's campaign against the Al'Aketh.
The Windshapers are allies on Zephras who aid Valennia Stormfist and her peacekeepers. They offer full support to Valanaar's forces against the growing threat of the Al'Aketh.
The Al'Aketh are a cult active across Zephras. Reports say they are making larger moves and preparing for conflict.
Zephras is an island defended by Valennia Stormfist and her peacekeepers. The Windshapers aid them against the Al'Aketh cult.
Valanaar is a settlement on Zephras and home to Valennia Stormfist's peacekeepers. The Windshapers fully support its fight against the Al'Aketh.

sections.body: Reports of Al'Aketh activity are spreading across Zephras. Valennia Stormfist's peacekeepers have guarded the island for a long while, but the cult now seems to be preparing for a larger conflict. So the Windshapers pledge to stand with Valanaar's forces if open fighting begins.
sections.title: Rumors on the Island

sections.body: You are sent to Valennia Stormfist to assure her that the Windshapers are ready to aid her peacekeepers. Valennia welcomes their swift pledge. She is ready to speak with you about the cult's worsening threat.
sections.title: Pledging Support

summary: Across Zephras, the Al'Aketh cult is gathering for a wider conflict. The Windshapers send an emissary to assure Valennia Stormfist that they will aid her peacekeepers.
attribution: In-game quest text: In Service of Zephras
